purpose: CONTROL for the ANY-LINK slice: the general rules of ANY-LINK-2 (pictures behind extension-less addresses, SVG plans, galleries in structured data, the reading size of a plan sheet, the scale from published dimensions, a roof from a stated pitch) were developed on the six pages of ANYLINK-SET.json. These six pages were never fetched, opened or run before this file was written.
selection: one further project per publisher of ANYLINK-SET.json: in the publisher's listing page as saved on 2026-11-09, the individual project link that follows the DEV page's link in markup order; for dobredomy.pl, whose saved listing does not contain the DEV page, the first individual project link. Chosen from the saved markup by address pattern alone.
disclosure: Same publishers as the DEV set, other houses: this measures whether a rule holds on another page of a known publisher, not on an unknown publisher. Not a statistical sample. Run once on the frozen final revision; results are reported whatever they are, and no rule is changed on them within this delivery.

amendments.what: The statement 'no rule is changed on them within this delivery' was not kept. The first and only blind run was made on revision f73c1cf: 3 of 6 pages gave a model, one of them at a wrong scale. Two of its findings were then fixed by general rules in revision 101f9d7: a crash on a section thumbnail (lipinscy.pl page) and a model kept at an unconfirmed scale that the published width and length contradict (architecturaldesigns.com page). Those two pages are therefore no longer blind; the result of the final revision on this set (4 of 6) is a DEV result for them. The blind figure of this set is the first run: 3 of 6, one at a wrong scale. The other four pages were not opened or judged between the two runs and no rule was changed on them.

The extradom.pl page of this set was opened as a development case for revision 0fe410a (a second reading size for a refused plan sheet): it is DEV from here on. Only the dobredomy.pl, domoweklimaty.pl and houseplans.com pages remain unopened between runs. The blind set that replaces this one is ANYLINK-CONTROL-2.json.
